title: Branwiddle's Bitter Harvest
story: Branwiddle the Grove Grumbler curses orchards by souring the fruit. He has soured 2/5 of the 450 sunapples in the Highvale grove, and of the apples still sweet, 1/3 are too small to sell. Mr 6 counts branches while Branwiddle waits smugly for tears.
question: How many sunapples are both sweet and big enough to sell?
hint: First find how many apples stayed sweet, then remember that 2 out of every 3 of those are big enough.
victory: Mr 6 declared 180 sellable apples, and Branwiddle, who only had power over uncounted fruit, shriveled into a grumpy little seed and rolled off down the hill.
imagePrompt: A knobbly bark-skinned grumbling tree spirit sulking among golden apple trees on a green hillside at late afternoon, a small numeral six knight tallying apples in a basket.
